=== client roles ===
app-access id=644a1a27-1a9d-4e89-9bcf-ed860be4aaea
editor id=a63ade80-bee4-4df5-99b7-183fae9bfdd7
{"error":"Role not found"}assign app-access: HTTP:404
{"error":"Role not found"}assign editor: HTTP:404
=== verify ===

observation.command: TOK=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && CID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && echo "=== client roles ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CID/roles" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[] | .name + " id=" + .id' && UID1=acf1a53a-9e6e-4c76-a983-2dac22d10526 && for role in app-access editor; do RID=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CID/roles/$role" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r .id); curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '[{"id":"'$RID'"}]' -w "assign $role: HTTP:%{http_code}\n"; done && echo "=== verify ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[].name'
